title: 1 Samuel Bible Quiz - Chapter 29
description: Ten questions on 1 Samuel 29: the Philistine princes refuse to let David go into battle with them, and Achish sends him back.

questions.text: Where did the Philistines gather all their armies?
questions.explanation: 1 Samuel 29:1 says the Philistines gathered together all their armies to Aphek.
The Israelites encamped by the spring which is in Jezreel.

questions.text: Where did David and his men march as the Philistines passed on?
questions.explanation: The lords of the Philistines passed on by hundreds and by thousands, and David and his men passed on in the rear with Achish.

answers.text: At the front, ahead of the lords
In a separate camp on a hill
Beside the princes in the middle

questions.explanation: The princes of the Philistines asked Achish, "What about these Hebrews?"

answers.text: The elders of Israel at Jezreel

questions.text: What did Achish say he had found in David since he fell away?
questions.explanation: Achish told the princes, "I have found no fault in him since he fell away until today."

questions.text: What were the princes afraid David would become in the battle?
questions.explanation: They said David should not go down with them to battle, lest in the battle he become an adversary to them.

questions.text: Which song did the princes recall that people sang about David?
questions.explanation: The princes reminded Achish that people sang in dances, "Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands."

answers.text: "David has slain his thousands, and Saul his ten thousands"
"Saul has slain his thousands, and David his ten thousands"

questions.text: Why did Achish tell David to go back?
questions.explanation: Achish said David had been upright, but "the lords don't favor you," so he should return in peace.

answers.text: Because David had lied to him
Because Saul had asked for David
Because the lords did not favor him
Because the army had enough men

questions.text: To what did Achish compare David in his sight?
questions.explanation: Achish answered David, "I know that you are good in my sight, as an angel of God."

questions.text: Where did David and his men go when they left early in the morning?
questions.explanation: David and his men rose up early to return into the land of the Philistines, while the Philistines went up to Jezreel.

answers.text: Up to Jezreel with the army
Back into the land of the Philistines
